$comment: Root ADR-0445. Who acts when a host unit fails. Every infra/systemd unit that reports its failure (OnFailure=foundation-unit-failed@) names one of these owners in its [Unit] line X-Foundation-Owner= and its runbook in Documentation= (systemd ignores X- lines). The asset reconciler copies both into each failed unit's series (foundation-units.prom), and the FoundationUnitFailedLong rule calls the owner by name once a unit has stayed failed for six hours. orchestration/tests/test_unit_owners.py refuses a unit without an owner listed here or without a runbook that exists.
